repair.attempt76_failure_addressed: the exact active disposable route passed before the Python urllib upload rejected without a bounded transport or Worker-stage classification
repair.diagnostic_envelope: the Python subprocess emits exact-key JSON only, caps stdout and parsed HTTP error bodies at 4096 bytes, accepts no stderr, and requires exact failure exit code 2
repair.secret_and_raw_data_policy: URL, query, capability, request body, response body, headers, and raw exception strings are never persisted, logged, or returned by the classifier
repair.http_worker_policy: every HTTP error is exact-version-bound and only allowlisted Worker codes paired with exact fixed statuses are promoted to stable parent codes
repair.transport_policy: timeout, TLS certificate, DNS or network, unknown, generic HTTP 4xx, generic HTTP 5xx, and other HTTP outcomes remain distinct safe parent codes
repair.capability_put_policy: prewrite R2 head, request-body read, R2 bucket write, postwrite R2 head, and postwrite fact mismatch now have bounded distinct outcomes
repair.real_python_integration: real python3 urllib framing passes through a loopback HTTP adapter into the actual disposable output-port handler backed by in-memory R2
repair.active_route_proof: three consecutive 403 V207_AUTHORITY_REJECTED responses carrying the exact active control-plane version remain required
repair.propagation_bound: at most 30 reads and 60 seconds with every fetch timeout and retry sleep capped by the remaining active-phase deadline
repair.pre_gpu_probe: the exact Python urllib PUT, FINALIZE, GET authority, byte readback, and deterministic DELETE sequence remains required before any RunPod mutation or GPU dispatch
repair.source_identity: the pre-GPU compatibility probe and every later output-port response remain bound to the exact active Cloudflare Worker version
repair.retry_policy: no upload retry, GPU retry, qualification retry, or redispatch

stop_conditions: any control source, image source, published image digest, image lineage, config, GPU, region, rate, volume, billing, capacity, disposable-name, or policy drift
the fixed disposable output Worker name is present or its absence is not proven exactly
the exact active route version is not proven by three consecutive exact fingerprints within 30 reads and 60 seconds
the exact Python urllib pre-GPU upload/finalize/readback/delete probe does not pass and clean up
the Python diagnostic envelope is malformed, oversized, noisy, incorrectly status-paired, missing exact version identity, or returns an unrecognized Worker code
any capability PUT prewrite head, body read, bucket write, postwrite head, or output-write confirmation stage fails
any later response is missing or differs from the exact active Cloudflare Worker version
any malformed, unrelated, permanent 4xx, cleanup, reconciliation, or cumulative-cap uncertainty
any shared staging Worker mutation, image republication, GPU fallback, anchor refresh, volume mutation, retry or redispatch, or V2-08 action
